name: Prologue
description: GTA 6 opens with Lucia standing in her jail cell in Hamlet Correctional, looking out the window. Turn around, focus on a cellmate, and press the corresponding button to talk to them. Tip: You can't actually escape here. The chase is scripted, and after a while the game cuts back to the counsellor's office on its own, so don't waste time trying to find a way out.

name: Gone Fishing
description: The mission opens with Jason and his friend Cal out on a boat. Donnie, a pilot, drops drug packages from his plane into the sea. Drive after the plane and slow down next to each package so Cal can fish it out of the water. Tip: The binoculars can also be used to study animals. Studying 100 of the 255 species counts towards 100% completion, so scan every new animal you come across.

name: Gear Up
description: Jason needs a longarm, so head to the Ammu-Nation store close to his house. The car parked outside the house will get you there.

name: Unwanted Attention
description: Talk to Cal on the beach in the north of Key Lento. Brian is owed a payment that is sitting in the trunk of an Imponte Phoenix, and the car has ended up in the police impound in Hamlet. Tip: Use the WAiNK app on your phone to scan nearby vehicles. Scanning 200 of the 277 base vehicles counts towards 100% completion, so scan every new car you see.

name: Lab Fees
description: Brian wants his rent from a gift shop that is really a front for an acid lab. When you reach the marker, the boutique is locked. Call Brian on your phone to access the shop, which properly starts the mission. Talk to the man behind the register, and he admits he doesn't have the money. Tip: Fences like Brian buy stolen narcotics, jewellery, and marked bills. More fences unlock as the story progresses, and they all appear with green icons on the map. Stolen goods are carried in a bag, which you c

name: Pipework
description: Brian sends Jason to collect the rent from Mandy, one of his tenants. Talk to her outside her house. She refuses to pay until her blocked sink is fixed. Tip: Pick up the cigar box from the street on your way out to get the Macizo Cigar.

name: Just a Scratch
description: Jason's car needs some work. Take his personal vehicle, the '70 Ganado parked at his house, to the marker at Coastal Auto Care. If you've already wrecked the Ganado, make a manual save and load it from the pause menu: you'll respawn at home with the car parked outside. Tip: This is also a favor for Lucia: the map note says she will appreciate having the car fixed up before she gets out.

name: Get Shirley's Rum
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Gear Up, Lab Fees, Just a Scratch and Unwanted Attention: Shirley then calls out to Jason near her house in Key Lento on the way to Pipework. It's missable and disappears once you start Tourist Trap. Tip: Both of Shirley's missions can only be completed in Chapter 1 and disappear for good once you start Tourist Trap. They aren't needed for any trophy or for 100% completion.

name: Steal the Scooter
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Get Shirley's Rum and waiting about a day for Shirley to call out to Jason again. It's missable and disappears once you start Tourist Trap.

name: Hey Arnold!
description: After the run-in with the Kingfishers, Brian 's long-time broker, Arnold, has stopped answering his calls. Talk to Brian at the pool bar south of Key Lento. Tip: Stunt jumps stay marked on the map even after you complete them. Filter the map for the Exploration icons (the magnifying glass) to see them all.

name: Island Dreams
description: Talk to Kenton in his Island Dreams shop by the beach. Kenton is a treasure hunter, and he's using a bachelor party dive trip to a shipwreck as cover for his search. Three guys from the party join you on the boat. Tip: While diving, you can study fish and other sea creatures just by swimming close to them. They count towards the 100 animals needed for 100% completion.

name: Feng Shui
description: Shortly after the Hey Arnold mission, you receive a text message from Cal, and a mission marker appears at Jason's house. The mission starts as soon as you walk in.

name: Pick Up Groceries
description: Before Lucia comes home, stock up the house. Go into the marked grocery store in Key Lento and pick up the products highlighted with pink markers (they also show as pink dots on the minimap). Any three items will do. Each product is paid for the moment you take it off the shelf, so there's no need to go to the register.

name: Buy Flowers
description: Talk to the vendor at the marked flower stand in the south of Key Lento. You can buy a Large Bouquet for $10 or Roses for $25. Lucia will appreciate either, but the vendor comments on your choice, so go with the roses. The flowers are delivered to the house later, and there's nothing else to do.

name: Buy Lucia a Necklace
description: The jewellery store The Siren's Chest is in the south of Key Lento, right next to the barbershop from Get The Chop. Tip: This purchase is worth it. In Chapter 2, Lucia can offer the necklace as collateral, which gives you an easier outcome in a later mission.

name: Get The Chop
description: Go into the Barnacle Beauties salon, next to the jewellery store from Buy Lucia a Necklace. Talk to the stylist and pay for any new haircut. You can also change your hair color and trim or style your beard. Tip: Unlike clothes, hairstyles don't stay unlocked. If you want to go back to an old look later, you'll have to pay for it again.

name: Get Lucia's Clothes
description: Some time after Feng Shui, an Unknown Caller rings Jason: it's Andy, a friend of Lucia's. Answer the call, and head over to the Manatee's Rest Bar in Key Lento to pick up some clothes for Lucia. Tip: Keep the bag in the trunk and bring it with you when you pick Lucia up from prison in Coming Home. Drive carefully so you don't lose it.

name: Catch a Bigger Fish
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Feng Shui in Chapter 1, after which Cal texts Jason to challenge him to a fishing contest in Gambit Bay. Tip: The challenge stays active after Chapter 1, so you can come back for it later if you missed it.

name: Coming Home
description: The morning after Feng Shui, Lucia calls to say she'll be released soon. The mission is marked at Hamlet Correctional, but you have to pass time until she calls again. Use this window for the five optional missions: Pick Up Groceries, Buy Flowers, Buy Lucia a Necklace, Get The Chop, and Get Lucia's Clothes. They all improve your relationship with Lucia, and the necklace is useful later in Chapter 2. It's also worth repairing Jason's house: fix the bedroom wall and paint it, the broken stairs, th

name: Clean Up After Donnie
description: The morning after Coming Home, Donnie calls Jason. One of the packages from his botched drop is sending a signal near a fishing spot in the swamps southwest of Hamlet. Head to the search area and ask the fisherman on the docks. He points you to the package on the shore, under a roof.

name: Buck Me
description: About half a day after Coming Home, Lucia calls Jason and tells him that she needs a bank account to receive her community service payments. Neither of them has one, so Jason agrees to meet her at the Fleeca branch in Key Lento. Tip: Money in Family Savings can never be withdrawn, but it can never be lost either. Each savings goal unlocks discounts and raises your checking account limit. Purchases over $1,000 are paid through BuckMe, and you lose your pocket cash when you die, so it's best to de

name: Down to Earth
description: Once both Clean Up After Donnie and Buck Me are done, talk to Brian in his office at the marina and follow him outside to Cal and one of the boats.

name: Meditate with Lucia
description: The mission is unlocked by talking to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason’s house, the morning after Down to Earth, then following her out to the balcony. It’s missable and only available in Chapter 1. Tip: Meditate with Lucia is missable: it’s only available in Chapter 1 and can’t be done later.

name: Find the Lost Drugs
description: This starts with a phone call after Down to Earth. Four search zones appear in the swamps, each hiding one to three drug packages. The packages beep and have a flashing yellow light. Collect them and sell them to a fence ( Brian or Donnie ), and try not to die or lose the bag along the way. Tip: Do this before Clear Skies to earn the most: the packages sell for $3,400 to Donnie or $2,720 to Brian.

name: Deposit Cash Into BuckMe
description: This task has no map marker: you'll find it in the mission list (open the map and select the storybook icon). Open the BuckMe app on your phone and choose "ATM Finder – Set Destination" to mark the nearest ATM. There's one right next to Jason's house. Tip: Pocket cash is lost when you die, while money in your account is much safer. If you carry no cash at all, purchases are paid directly through BuckMe, so there's little reason to keep money in your pocket.

name: Save for the Future
description: Save for the Future has no map marker and runs through the entire story; you'll find it in the mission list. Use the BuckMe app on your phone to move money from your checking account into Family Savings. Each time you reach a goal, a new one unlocks after further story progress. It isn't required to advance the story. Tip: Try to have at least $5,000 in Family Savings before starting Recalibration and Tourist Trap at the end of Chapter 1, because you lose all the pocket cash you bring into those

name: Day Release
description: After Down to Earth, Kat and Mattia call to invite Jason and Lucia out. Go to the Rusty Anchor and order a drink from the bartender at the back to start the cutscene. Mattia's henchman Burim removes Lucia's ankle monitor, and you can choose whether to shake Mattia's hand (it makes no difference). Tip: Don’t miss Lucia’s free sunglasses: while looking for Mattia on the yacht, go to the middle deck and talk to the couple by the railing near the stairs going down. You can’t get them later.

name: Clock Out
description: The mission is unlocked by accepting Lucia's call during the day after Day Release, when she finishes her shift early. Declining skips the mission, and you must pick her up before 4pm. It may only trigger once your relationship has reached Crazy in Love (3/4).

name: Clear Skies
description: After Down to Earth, Brian calls with a job for Jason and Donnie in Southwind. Go to the seaplane, and Donnie will send you to Brian, who is sitting at the tiki bar up the street. Tip: The bikers park several different motorcycles here, so it's a good spot to scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app.

name: Building a Life
description: This starts as soon as Clear Skies ends back at Jason's house, where Lucia is failing to assemble a coffee table. When they finish talking, interact with the left side of the table and help put the screws in. Jason then realizes the pieces are installed in the wrong order, so you have to unscrew it again.

name: Ring the Bell!
description: The mission is unlocked by a text from Cal after Day Release, while Jason is driving to the marina to meet Brian in Swamped: go to the Rusty Anchor before meeting Brian. It's missable and only available in Chapter 1. Tip: Ring the Bell! is missable: it's only available in Chapter 1, so stop by the Rusty Anchor before carrying on with Swamped.

name: Swamped
description: Once Day Release, Clear Skies, and Building a Life are complete, go into the back room of Brian 's Marina to start the mission. Get into Brian's truck and drive him to the Kingfishers camp in the northwest of Mariana County. At the entrance, you talk to one of the gang members, then get out and follow Brian on foot. Tip: Back home, tell Lucia about Brian's retirement when given the option. It improves your relationship, while keeping quiet gives you nothing.

name: Don Gone
description: Brian wants Donnie 's trailer to look as if he packed up and left town, so nothing links him to the operation. Go into the trailer and pick up the bag on the bed. Tip: Before you destroy the car, open its trunk to collect Donnie's H&L.38, a unique weapon variant. If you skip it, it's gone for good.

name: Donnie's Lost Drugs
description: Brian mentioned that Donnie sank his boat off Corsair Key with drugs still on board. The search area is in the Atlantic off the northern coast of Key Lento: steal one of the boats near the shore, because swimming out there takes far too long.

name: Recalibration
description: During or after Don Gone and Donnie's Lost Drugs, Lucia calls, and the mission starts when you get home. Cal is grieving, and Lucia suggests cheering him up. Go to the marked liquor store and take any six-pack of beer from the fridge; it's paid for as soon as you pick it up.

name: Tourist Trap
description: ⚠️ Point of no return: this is your last chance to free roam in Chapter 1. Make a manual save in a separate slot before starting, and put at least $5,000 into Family Savings: you lose all your pocket cash and the Key Lento house for good. Side content such as Kenton 's treasure dives, Cal 's fishing and the Kingfishers hideouts comes back later in the game. Tip: Lucia starts this mission with base health and Focus, so play carefully. On the way out of the interrogation room, grab the Moreland 85

name: Home Sweet Home
description: This starts immediately after Tourist Trap, with Lucia back at Jason's house to collect some of his belongings before they skip town. Go inside: two robbers have trashed the place and set it on fire. Fight them off. There's no time left to reach the cash, so run out of the front door before the house explodes. Tip: Before leaving, grab Tomás ’ photo from the small shelf to the left of the front door. If you call Andy and reach her car without being spotted, Lucia unlocks Andy’s Jacket, which you

name: Discharge Time
description: Lucia rushes to Vice City Hospital to see Jason. From the start, go left and up the stairs to the second floor. You can ask the receptionist for directions, or just follow the pink line on the floor through the door on the left. Jason is in room 203.

name: What's in the Bag?
description: Chapter 2 begins straight after Discharge Time. Lucia has checked herself and the wounded Jason into a motel room in Port Gellhorn, where they can lie low while he recovers. On the news, Captain Méndez, the dirty cop from the Visitor Center, is blaming them for the attack. Tip: Chapter 2 is mostly played as Lucia while Jason recovers. The Paradise Lost trophy / achievement for completing Chapter 1 unlocks during this short mission.

name: Ambulance Chaser
description: The mission is marked as soon as you first leave the motel room after What's in the Bag?. The ambulance is hidden in a barn just east of the Starlet Motel: take the stairs at the back to get in. A group of addicts has found it and they drive off in it. Tip: This mission is missable: if you don’t do it before Slam Dunk, the police find the ambulance and the objective disappears. Failing to stop the junkies or destroy the ambulance also hurts Jason and Lucia’s relationship and can raise the motel

name: Play Nurse
description: This mission has no map marker of its own: you'll find it in the main mission list under Map > Story. It runs throughout Chapter 2 and can't be completed straight away. Go back to Jason's room at the Starlet Motel at the end of each day to see if he needs anything. From time to time a cutscene plays where Lucia looks after him, which improves your relationship. Tip: You can't miss this one. Returning to the motel is required at several points in the chapter (the motel icon turns pink when it's n

name: Overnight Charges
description: Leave the motel room and head into the reception on your left. Linda, the manager, isn't very welcoming and insists the room is paid for right now. Tip: Inspect the map on the reception wall to uncover the whole Port Gellhorn area on your map.

name: Just Moved In
description: Go to the gas station across the street from the Starlet Motel and enter the Alpha convenience store. Eight items are marked on the minimap: soda, protein bars, fruit, soup, gauze, bandanas, hair clippers and a makeup bag. Each item is paid for as soon as you take it from the shelf, so there's no need to talk to the clerk. Tip: The shopping comes to $55, and taking care of Jason this way improves his relationship with Lucia.

name: Girls' Trip
description: After Overnight Charges and Just Moved In, a search area appears at the Starlet Motel. Talk to Zach, who is peeking through windows between your room and the reception: he tells you to see Vicki in Room 10. Knock on her door and pay her $50 for some pills. Tip: Once this mission is done, Chapter 2 opens up: steal a car and take it to Moses first, as having your own ride makes getting around Port Gellhorn much easier.

name: Pick Up a Gun
description: This short optional mission is marked after Girls' Trip. Go into the Ammu-Nation in Port Gellhorn and either buy a weapon or use the green weapon locker to take back one of the guns you already own. Tip: Optional missions show as black icons with pink letters on the map. You need to complete 100 optional missions for the 100% Completion checklist, so do them whenever they appear.

name: Moses
description: After Girls' Trip, drive any car into Moses 's garage in Port Gellhorn to meet him. If the car you bring has no tracker, you'll be able to register it at the end of the mission; if it has one, Moses sends you out to find an untracked vehicle later. Tip: Cheap cars usually have no tracker, mid-range cars have standard trackers that alert the police where you stole them, and supercars have advanced trackers that call the cops if you drive too slowly. Advanced trackers need the Key Cloner, which yo

name: New Look
description: This one takes about a minute. Go to the Pearl House Hair Salon in Port Gellhorn, talk to the stylist and buy any hairstyle to complete the mission. If you're short on cash, mug someone or rob a store's register first. Tip: Bring around $150. Lucia can also do the Wavy Topknot herself in any mirror at home, as long as her hair is long enough.

name: How Do I Look?
description: Head to the Bargain World clothing store in the south of Port Gellhorn and buy a new top and a pair of pants or shorts. Anything will do, and there's plenty to choose from. Tip: The cheapest way to finish is the Bargain World Ensemble on the mannequin, for $46.

name: Got Pills?
description: This is a waiting mission with no map marker: it appears in the mission list after Girls' Trip and completes on its own. Dunk calls after a few in-game days, and the best way to speed things up is to work on the other available missions, such as Pick Up a Gun, Moses, New Look, How Do I Look? and Ambulance Chaser. Tip: Three cats live around the Starlet Motel: praise them until they come closer, then pet and feed them for a Focus boost, Professional criminal profile points and a little progress t

name: Daily Driver
description: Shortly after Moses, he texts you a picture of the car he wants: an '82 Canis Crawler parked by the old Traders' Union building. It's the white jeep in the middle of the search area. There are a few enemies around: take them out or just run to the car and drive off. Tip: Soon after, Moses gifts you the Port Gellhorn Garage to store vehicles, and you unlock the Vice City Real Estate app, which lets you buy more garages.

name: Behind on Payments
description: The mission is unlocked by having at least $900 to pay Linda for the motel room. Tip: The rent is $900 if you talked to Linda right away, or $1,080 if you went grocery shopping first and she came to the room. Paying it gets Lucia’s necklace back.

name: Slam Dunk
description: After the other Chapter 2 missions and Dunk 's two calls in Painkiller Supplier, the mission is marked at Dunk's trailer in Port Gellhorn. Follow Dunk to a spot behind a dumpster and wait for Doctor Bill to show up at the convenience store. Tip: Loot Bill's body before you leave for around $1,000 extra.

name: Breakfast Run
description: After Slam Dunk, wait for Jason's call (around half a day; finishing any other pending main missions helps). The motel icon turns pink: go back to the room. A cutscene shows time passing until Jason is fully healed, and the couple decides to go on a robbery spree. First, drive to Hank's Waffles. Tip: This mission unlocks the Trust trophy / achievement and makes Jason playable again.

name: Coffee Break
description: This starts right after Breakfast Run, with Jason and Lucia outside the Starlet Motel. The kitchen is straight ahead, in the southern corner of the motel. On the way, you bump into Wyman, who suggests checking out the Mud Club for some dirt racing. Wyman is the man you could have helped repair his car in a random encounter in front of the motel earlier. Tip: Your BuckMe account is upgraded to Silver: you can now hold up to $100,000, the Family Savings goal rises to $100,000 too, and RydeMe rides

name: Thrillbillies
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Coffee Break and meeting Wyman outside the motel, who points you to the Thrillbilly Mud Club.

name: Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Thrillbillies and waiting a few in-game hours for Billy's text message. Tip: The Highwayman Sanchez is excellent for off-road stunt jumps. Park it in a garage after the mission and register it at Moses 's shop to keep it.

name: Hit Avery Pawn
description: This is one of the four jobs marked after Coffee Break. Go to the pawn shop in Port Gellhorn, pull out your gun and threaten the staff, then smash the display cases to grab the jewellery. If you threaten them, they may also give you the code for the safe in the back (it may be randomized). In our case, the code was: 6943.

name: Hit Kingpin Bowling
description: This is one of the four jobs marked after Coffee Break. The compound is full of Kolts gang members, so call your partner to come along (hold D-Pad Right and ask to meet up). Bring five Zombix from a convenience store, refill your body armor at Ammu-Nation, and buy sticky bombs there too: you need them for the safe. Tip: The trophy isn't missable. If you miss a valuable, the bowling alley respawns some weeks later in in-game time (during Chapter 3): grab whatever you missed and the trophy still u

name: Impounded Vehicle
description: Lucia's personal vehicle is impounded automatically after Breakfast Run. It shows as a green car icon on the map in Port Gellhorn, near the police station. Drive through the fence: the two officers there spot you and give you a two-star wanted level. Jump in Lucia's car and escape. Tip: This works as a tutorial for impounded vehicles. If you leave your personal vehicle in a police search area after a crime, it gets impounded. Later, you can get it back instantly through the Scooter Bros app for

name: Prepare for Vice City
description: The mission is unlocked by earning at least $15,000 (keep it safe in BuckMe) and finishing the other pending Chapter 2 missions. Tip: Deposit your cash into BuckMe as you go, so you don't lose it if you die. A while after you reach $15,000 and clear the other main missions, your motel room is marked as the next objective.

name: Afternoon Delight
description: Some time after Coffee Break, Vicki calls both of them about robbing her boss's strip club. If you go to the start alone, your partner is called in automatically. It's ladies' night, so the bouncer only lets Lucia in; as Jason, wait for the two bouncers at the back to walk away, climb the fence and go through the open door. You end up in the male dancers' dressing room, where lead dancer Mario wants Jason to join the show.

name: Checking Out
description: ⚠️ Point of no return: starting Checking Out ends Chapter 2, and the Starlet Motel stops being your home for good. Before you start it, use the motel for anything you still need (outfits, stored items), grab the two collectible cards inside it (#1 Vicki and #2 Victor Maravilla), and make a manual save in a separate slot. Tip: If you die during the bike chase, a bug can make Jason disappear as an objective and leave you with a police search area you can't escape. Restart the mission if that happe

name: Welcome to Vice City
description: Chapter 3 starts seamlessly after Checking Out, as Jason and Lucia drive into Vice City on the highway. After a short drive, Jason calls Dre'Quan, who asks you to meet him at the Jack of Hearts, the Crosstown strip club where he runs a record label. Tip: This mission unlocks the T**s Ass Drug Money trophy / achievement for completing Chapter 2. Afterwards, Moses texts you: Pay 'n' Sprays can now buy and register cars with Standard Trackers. For example, the Ubermacht '85 Sentinel you arrived in

name: Dealer's Choice
description: Head back to the Jack of Hearts. Go up the stairs and through the door at the top into the studio, then into the recording booth where Dre'Quan is waiting. Wait for him to finish recording; when he asks which hook you like, answer however you want (if you skip the session by asking to see Boobie, you miss this choice). Then follow him upstairs to Boobie, who tells Jason the apartment comes with a favor. Tip: If the cut deal turns into a shootout, grab the money bag from the back of the car first

name: Meet the Heders
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Dealer's Choice and letting Cal check the hard drive at the Bayside apartment. A day or two later Brian gets in touch; start the mission from the bag of clothes in the bedroom. Tip: When the waiter arrives, order the Surf and Turf that Lucia asks for to get a small relationship boost.

name: Dubious Provenance
description: Start the mission by interacting with the bag in the closet of the Bayside apartment. Head to Capri on the far west side of the map, by car or with a RideMe to save time. Try the front door of the antique store, and you'll go upstairs automatically. Tip: Afterwards, loot about $2,500 in jewellery and cash from the storage container, and take the '32 Hustler parked there to keep or sell.

name: Mami Knows Best
description: Play as Lucia and head to Peacock Bay to meet her mother, Mia. After talking to her, get in Mia's car and drive to the marked neighborhood in Hamlet, where her first property for sale is. Tip: Right after the mission, Lucia calls her aunt Lorena, which unlocks the option to send her $5,000 through the BuckMe app, all at once or in smaller payments.

name: Get Your Wheels
description: Get Your Wheels is added to your mission list automatically at the start of Chapter 3, once you move into the Bayside apartments after Dealer’s Choice. It has no map marker because you can complete it anywhere: open the story icon on the map to see it. Tip: Getting back one character’s car is enough to complete the mission, but both cars were impounded, so you can recover both if you want them.

name: Tyrone
description: Some time after Dealer's Choice, Tyrone, the dealer who supplies Boobie, lets Jason know he has more work for him. This is a Jason-only mission: drive back to Tyrone's apartment, the one you visited with Dre'Quan, and knock on the door. It takes a moment, but you're let in.

name: Here, Kitty Kitty
description: The mission is unlocked by completing the first part of Dubious Provenance, then going back to Tyrone at the apartment complex in La Perle as Jason.

name: Send Money to Lorena
description: There’s nowhere to go for this one: simply open your phone and send the money to Lorena to complete the mission.

name: Car Service
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Meet the Heders and waiting about a day for a message from Raul on a blocked number. The mission starts near the marker in Salton, south Vice City. Tip: A dog usually waits by one of the gate guards. Don't shoot it unless it attacks you: hurting dogs has a big negative effect on your criminal profile.

name: Send More Money to Lorena
description: There’s nowhere to go for this one: simply open your phone and send the money to Lorena to complete the mission. Exact same process, exact same amount, exact same screenshot above.

name: Top Billing
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Car Service, after which Dre'Quan invites you to the Jack of Hearts to see the Real Dimez perform.

name: Boobie Time
description: The mission is unlocked by completing the first part of Dubious Provenance, then going to the Jack of Hearts as Jason to meet Boobie. Tip: If you take the thief down from a distance, use Focus to spot the bag in the water. Killing the thieves here doesn't matter much for a Professional profile: getting Boobie's money back is what counts.

name: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
description: The mission is unlocked by completing the Chapter 3 story mission Boobie Time, after which Yasmani contacts you about the jobs. Tip: Be careful with your haul: if you die or get arrested, you lose everything you stole.

name: First Impressions
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Car Service. Raul asks you to collect a car and meet him: go to the garage on Waxman Island with both Jason and Lucia. Tip: To keep a Professional or Hardened criminal rating, aim at tires and engines to wreck the cruisers, and shoot officers in the legs instead of killing them. Shooting drivers works too, but it pushes your rating towards Violent. Watch Jason's health and heal from the inventory if needed.

name: Caught Slipping
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Boobie Time and First Impressions. It starts automatically the next time you try to enter the Bayside apartment during Chapter 3.

name: Crosstown Traffic
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Car Service and Raul's call. You can start it as Lucia at the Courtyard Bar in Stockyard or as Jason at the boatyard in La Perle: either one starts it for both.

name: Credit Check
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Crosstown Traffic. Raul calls you to meet the crew: go with both Jason and Lucia to the marker near the Vice Vinyl mod shop and use the intercom. Tip: Raul is testing whether you can work professionally: avoid killing civilians and don't hang around, or a large police response can make him call off the job.

name: Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Crosstown Traffic. Randy then asks you to steal a car parked at the Hathaway Apartments in Ocean Beach. Tip: Bring the car in without damage for a $10,000 bonus; otherwise Randy just makes fun of your driving.

name: Race Against Yago
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Bumper to Bumper, then waiting several in-game days for Yago's message to Jason. It's marked with a limited-time hourglass icon in Vice City, so do it as soon as it appears. Tip: Race Against Yago is missable: if the hourglass runs out, the mission disappears. It doesn't affect trophies or 100% completion.

name: Sinfrontera National Bank
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Credit Check. Raul then calls you to meet him at Sinfrontera National Bank in Tequesta.

name: Security Expert
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Sinfrontera National Bank, as it starts straight after it. Tip: You can also go in loud: two guards watch the front, one more is at the back and at least one arrives by car, and the gunfire brings the police. Either way, grab the collectible watch in the bedroom before taking Nicole, and leave in a car with room for three.

name: Heist Planning
description: Heist Planning isn’t a mission with its own objectives: it’s an entry in the mission list that tracks your progress towards The Cartel Heist. Its in-game card simply reads “Complete prep work” and explains that Raul is putting together a crew to rob the Sinfrontera National Bank, and that you need to follow his plan and get ready for the job. Tip: There’s nothing to do for Heist Planning itself: just play the prep missions as they show up on the map and it will be completed along the way.

name: Ride or Die
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Credit Check and waiting about a day for a text from Dre’Quan, then going alone as Jason to the Jack of Hearts in Crosstown. Tip: The basketball trick gets you the sneakers for free and saves you $1,580.

name: Company Property
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Security Expert and meeting Brian at Skeeter’s, in the south of Hamlet. Tip: Don't leave Pete behind during the escape: abandoning him permanently locks you out of some optional content later.

name: The Missing Link
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Company Property and going alone as Lucia to Sloppy Molly’s in Watson Bay. Tip: Kill the first enemy, then go back into the photo room before moving on: Monty's pistol is on the floor there. It's a variant weapon you can only get this way.

name: Safe Word
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Company Property and talking to Nicole at Raul’s compound in Stockyard. Tip: You can also tell Nicole you'll practice later and come back before the heist. If you fail a step, she resets it so you can try again, and the Simplified Mini Games option in the settings makes the minigame easier.

name: Cooties
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Ride or Die and waiting a couple of in-game days for Dre’Quan to call, then going to the marker in Crosstown.

name: South Leonida Real Estate
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Mami Knows Best and waiting for Mia to contact Lucia again, which can take several in-game days. Start it from the note on the door of her office in Hamlet. Tip: Mia's $2,000 commission takes a long time to arrive, but it does come after many in-game days.

name: Pick Up Shayna
description: The mission is unlocked by driving near Hamlet as Lucia, when her prison friend Shayna texts her asking for a ride. It’s only available for a limited time. Tip: This mission is only available for a limited time. It isn’t required for 100%, but if you want it, do it as soon as it is marked on the map.

name: Hidden Charges
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Company Property and Cooties, then answering Karim’s call to the planning room in Stockyard. Tip: You can plant the charges with one character or split the work between Jason and Lucia. Using both is quicker, because you don't have to run back to the van each time, and it also raises their relationship. Be careful: if you die or get arrested while carrying a charge, that charge is gone for good.

name: Bricked Up
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Hidden Charges and the other remaining Chapter 3 main missions, then going back to the Bayside apartment when Boobie gets in touch. Tip: Taking the red bag earns a Professional bonus and $3,500 from Boobie at the end. On the dark third floor, a police gun with a flashlight makes enemies much easier to spot.

name: The Cartel Heist
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Hidden Charges and every other Chapter 3 main mission, then meeting Raul at the planning room in Stockyard. Tip: Before the briefing, bring your own modded weapons: if you lost gear in Company Property, the crew's guns may have no mods. Practice the safe with Nicole first if you haven't yet.

name: Ocean Beach
description: The mission is unlocked by completing The Cartel Heist and going back to the Bayside apartment (you can head there straight away or later).

name: Another Life
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Ocean Beach, as it starts right after it.

name: Pool Day
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Another Life, as it starts right after it.

name: Attend Eddie Acosta's Party
description: The mission is unlocked by a text invitation from Eddie Acosta, who you meet at the hotel bar during the Chapter 4 mission Pool Day. You have to go to the party at Heathcliff Heights alone.

name: Company Cars
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Pool Day and talking to Santino in the Y Hotel lobby. Tip: The hotel car service works as a free taxi you can call from the front of the Y Hotel at any time.

name: Lawyer Up
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Pool Day and waiting for Valentina to call about a lawyer, then going to Abe Gonzalez’s office Downtown.

name: Party Hard
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Lawyer Up and taking Valentina’s security job, starting at VCIA. Tip: Pick off enemies one at a time from cover with the silenced pistol: getting spotted turns the whole floor against you.

name: Heavy Lifting
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Lawyer Up and waiting for Raul to ask for the hard drive, then going to the storage locker. Tip: If the marker starts turning yellow, ease off the accelerator and let another car get between you and the bodybuilders.

name: It's a Date!
description: Right after Heavy Lifting, a date for Jason and Lucia is marked on the map at the Courtyard Bar in Stockyard, Vice City. Head there with both of them together. Tip: It’s one of the shortest missions in the game, and skipping it has no consequences, but it’s a quick and easy relationship boost for Jason and Lucia.

name: Photo/Shoot
description: After Party Hard, Dre’Quan gets in touch because he needs a hand with a promo shoot for the Dimez. Head to the marked building in Tequesta, follow him into the elevator and up onto the roof. Tip: After the second jump more cars join the chase: these ones you can shoot, so take them out before they ram or shoot you.

name: Bad Driver!
description: The mission is unlocked by completing Party Hard, after which Andrea asks you to deal with Felipe in Millport. It’s missable and becomes unavailable once you start Power Play. Tip: Bad Driver! is missable: if you start Power Play before doing it, the mission is gone for good.

name: Making Gainz
description: A couple of in-game days after Heavy Lifting, Raul contacts Lucia about the next step of his plan. Go to the planning room with Lucia alone to start the mission. Tip: From this point Jason and Lucia can’t be seen together in public until VCIA Takedown : they can only hang out in their room at the Y Hotel. If you like spending time with both of them, do any couple activities before starting Making Gainz, or play the next story missions back to back.

name: Too Much Baggage
description: After Making Gainz, Raul decides Jason will help scope out Vice City International Airport. Drive there, talk to the guard and park inside the lot, then walk to the nearby office to meet Andrea.

name: Watch It
description: After Making Gainz, Dre’Quan wants Jason’s help to impress the owner of a nightclub. Go to the marked store, head upstairs and wait for Dre’Quan to finish with the clerk, then follow him back to the car.

name: Cash Injections
description: After Amateur Hour, Nate texts Lucia asking her to call him so they can hang out. You can call him yourself, or wait about a day until he calls her. Then go to the Muscle Beach gym on Ocean Beach to meet him.

name: Amateur Hour
description: After your first workout with the crew, go back to Ajax Gym as Lucia. On the Trauma Floor, talk to Francisco, who is deadlifting on the stage. Cisco wants help with a porn director who owes him money, and Lucia sees a chance to win him over. Tip: Aim for the tyres: once they are blown out the camper stops almost immediately.

name: Dirty Work
description: Once Too Much Baggage and Cash Injections are both done, Lucia has Cisco and Nate on her side but still can’t win over Raina. Andrea has a plan: go to the planning room with Jason or Lucia to start the mission.

name: Adventures in Babysitting
description: Some time after Making Gainz, Jason is called to work security for Andrés de León again. Drive to his house on Starfish Island and follow Paulo round to the back to meet Andrés, then drive to The Vault nightclub. Tip: Watch out for the civilians running away during the shootout if you want to keep a good Criminal Profile rating.

name: Fresh Evidence
description: Once both Watch It and Adventures in Babysitting are done, Dre’Quan calls Jason to deliver on his promise to the club owner. Go to his office at Jack of Hearts, focus on him and tell him you’re ready, then follow him out to the car waiting in the alley.

name: Power Play
description: After Child’s Play, Lucia is asked to help Kordell ’s crew with a robbery. Go to their base in Salton, talk to the receptionist and head down the hall on the left to the room where the crew is waiting.

name: Child's Play
description: After Fresh Evidence, Andrés calls Jason for help getting his son Rafa back from the kidnappers. Go to Megamundo HQ in Downtown as Jason or Lucia. Tip: The map makes it look like this mission is on a timer, but it isn’t: you’ll simply be forced to play it once every other Jason and Lucia mission before Power Play is done. Doing it earlier makes no difference to the story.

name: Headliners
description: Once the VCIA Takedown setup jobs are out of the way, Dre’Quan gets in touch and asks for help with the Dimez launch party at Club VYB in Washington Beach. You can start it as either Jason or Lucia. Tip: A strong lineup is Donatello Lambrini (you deal with his assistant), who has by far the most followers, the Game Developer, who makes the biggest upfront offer, and KD, who has the second-biggest following and a history with Dre’Quan.

name: Close Surveillance
description: After Power Play, Karim has a plan to find the mole Kordell ’s crew has inside the airport. As Jason, go up to the top floor of the marked parking garage in Ocean Beach and meet him by his van. Francisco and Nate are on the move: Karim handles the microphone, so Jason takes the controls of the spy drone. Tip: The drone flies much like a helicopter and keeps the same height on its own: use the triggers to go up and down.

name: Delivery Method
description: After Power Play, Andrea has a plan to help Lucia get through airport security on the day of the heist, when she’ll pose as the wine authenticator. Go to the planning room as Jason to meet her. Tip: Be quick: if you take too long, someone comes back into the building and you’ll be caught and reported for trespassing.

name: Team Building
description: After Power Play, Kordell asks Lucia to meet him at Ajax Gym. Talk to him, then follow him outside and get into his car in the alley. Tip: Block and dodge with the prompt shown on screen, then hit back with melee attacks: timing your dodges makes these fights much easier.

name: Fully Catered
description: After Power Play, Raul calls about stealing a catering truck from the airport for the heist. The job usually shows up a little after Close Surveillance and Delivery Method. You can play it as either Jason or Lucia: head to the marked spot at the airport.

name: VCIA Takedown
description: Before you start: the heist only unlocks once every setup job is done: Making Gainz, Too Much Baggage, Amateur Hour, Cash Injections, Dirty Work, Adventures in Babysitting, Power Play, Close Surveillance, Delivery Method, Team Building, Fully Catered and Headliners. Then head to the planning room as either Jason or Lucia to kick it off. Tip: Shoot Omar in the leg or knock him out instead of killing him to get the Professional bonus.

name: Tie Up Loose Ends
description: Tie Up Loose Ends isn’t a regular mission with a marker to follow: it’s the waiting period right after VCIA Takedown. Raul has the hard drive and is supposed to get in touch about selling it, so the game simply asks you to wait for his message. There is no map marker for it, but it appears in the story list on your map as a mandatory main mission with a pink icon. Tip: Calling Valentina back is not strictly required, but it makes Sunset show up much sooner. If you skip the call, the story only m

name: That's Where the Money Is…
description: The mission is unlocked by completing VCIA Takedown, after which Yasmani gets in touch with a tip about a security van. Tip: Take every marked bill you can: a full haul is worth around $80,000.

name: Sunset
description: ⚠️ Point of no return: starting Sunset moves the story into Chapter 5. Finish any side activities you want to do first. Tip: You start the shootout with a high wanted level and enemies flanking from several directions, so never stay out in the open for long.

name: Starting From Zero
description: Starting From Zero kicks off as soon as Sunset ends, the moment you get control of Jason and Lucia back. Tip: If you have cash on you, a quick stop at a nearby clothing store for new outfits makes Jason and Lucia harder to recognize. It helps, but it is not required.

name: Bird in the Hand
description: Bird in the Hand begins right after Starting From Zero, the last mission of Chapter 4. Tip: Reach the hatch without being detected to get the Professional bonus.

name: Taking Liberties
description: Taking Liberties starts automatically once Bird in the Hand is over and you are back in Giorgio’s penthouse.

name: Doggie Bag
description: After Taking Liberties, talk to Vinny on the balcony by the pool in Giorgio ’s penthouse to start the mission. Giorgio needs a way to sniff out a cocaine shipment hidden on a huge container ship, and Vinny’s plan is to borrow Rocco, the coast guard’s best drug dog. Tip: Lucia’s silenced pistol is loaded with non-lethal rounds, so a headshot knocks guards out without killing them.

name: VC Baby
description: After Taking Liberties, walk over to Kat and Mattia where they are sitting in Giorgio ’s penthouse to start the mission. Kat has gone into labor, and Mattia needs to get her to the hospital. Tip: Reach the hospital in time for the birth to earn the mission’s top bonus.

name: Operation Savage Glory
description: Operation Savage Glory starts automatically back at the penthouse once both Doggie Bag and VC Baby are done. Tip: When Kevin warns you that the net is about to hit a tower, move to the right side of the net. Do the same when he warns you about the train, or the cargo slams into it with you on the wrong side.

name: Honest Abe
description: Honest Abe starts the first time you leave the penthouse after Operation Savage Glory. Giorgio has arranged a deal that could solve Jason and Lucia’s legal problems.

name: Unfinished Business
description: Unfinished Business is a short story step rather than a full mission, and it starts right after Honest Abe. The hard drive deal is being wrapped up in the background, so the game gives you a choice of pace: use the free time to finish any side activities you still have open, or move the story forward by going ahead with Abe ’s offer.

name: Protective Custody
description: ⚠️ Spoiler warning: this walkthrough covers the finale of GTA 6 and reveals how the different endings play out. Stop here if you haven’t finished the story yet. Tip: Make a manual save in a spare slot before starting the finale: missions can’t be replayed and the single autosave is overwritten after every mission. For the best ending you also need Jason and Lucia’s relationship at Hot Together, $2,000,000 in Family Savings and clean Criminal Profiles.

name: The End of the Road
description: ⚠️ Spoiler warning: this walkthrough covers the finale of GTA 6 and reveals how the different endings play out. Stop here if you haven’t finished the story yet. Tip: It’s a long mission, about 25 minutes before the final choice, so bring body armor and grenades.
